item.title: Water Cycle With Exact Labels

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen water-cycle explainer with a friendly voice-over you write. Show water rising, clouds forming, then rain. Label those stages exactly “Evaporation”, “Condensation”, and “Precipitation”, in that order. No other on-screen text.

item.tests: Tests exact rendered labels, correct stage mapping, and coordinated original narration in a short explainer.

answer_sheet.Exact on-screen labels: Evaporation; Condensation; Precipitation. Use that capitalization and order, without quotation marks.
answer_sheet.Other text: No other on-screen text, including subtitles.
answer_sheet.Voice and language: Friendly English voice; specific voice is your call.

must_haves: One approximately 10-second widescreen video has a friendly, intelligible English voice-over explaining the depicted cycle.
Water rises as vapor, clouds form, and rain falls, in that order.
The visible labels read exactly 'Evaporation', 'Condensation', and 'Precipitation', with no misspellings.
Each label is legible and appears with its corresponding stage, in the requested order.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an exactly 10-second 16:9 widescreen educational animated water-cycle explainer, friendly polished colorful 2D motion graphics, clear simple shapes, suitable for a general audience. One continuous landscape with a lake, green hills, warm sun, and sky, static camera. Sequentially demonstrate these three stages in this exact order, with only ONE stage label visible at a time: 0.0–3.3 seconds: sun warms lake water, translucent blue wisps and upward arrows rise from the water into the sky. Show the exact correctly spelled label "Evaporation". 3.3–6.5 seconds: rising vapor cools and gathers into fluffy clouds, small droplets coalesce. Remove the first label and show only the exact label "Condensation". 6.5–10.0 seconds: clouds release visible rain falling back into the lake. Remove the second label and show only the exact label "Precipitation". The ONLY on-screen text in the entire video is those three exact stage labels, in that order. No title, subtitles, captions, logos, additional words or ending text. Use large readable dark labels against the light sky. Generate synchronized audio with a warm, friendly, clear English narrator speaking this exact script naturally, beginning immediately and finishing within 10 seconds: "Sunshine warms water into vapor. It cools into clouds, then falls as rain. That's the water cycle!" Match 'Sunshine warms water into vapor' to the rising water stage, 'It cools into clouds' to clouds forming, and 'then falls as rain' to rainfall. Voice prominent, no music, only very subtle water ambience. Ensure all three stages and labels appear clearly before the video ends.
